title: Protocol
description: An assay protocol as an ordered list of steps. Units: volume in microlitres (volume_ul), time in seconds (duration_s), temperature in degrees C (temp_c), flow in microlitres per minute (flow_ul_min).

id.description: Unique protocol id, lowercase snake_case. Used in run file names.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the twin's dropdown.

source.description: Citation of the published protocol this is based on.

placeholder.description: true while this file holds fake values.

snake_id.description: lowercase snake_case, e.g. exchange_1, split_3, wash_buffer

operation.description: A chip operation. valve: open or close valves (targets = valve ids). culture: keep chambers in culture with batch medium exchanges and stop-flow between them. collect: take supernatant out through each chamber's outlet. harvest: send the cells out through each chamber's outlet. encapsulate: make capsules at a nozzle. cure: light-cure the capsules in a trap. mix: mix a reagent into the cell stream in a mixer (optionally diluting it). transfer: move the cells from source to target (a chamber or an outlet port), through whatever lies between. count: read the cell count and viability at a QC window.

target.description: Chamber or port id from the chip spec. For split: the chamber the capsules leave. For pool: the chamber they arrive in. Give target or targets.

targets.description: Several chambers (or valves, for operation valve) at once. An exchange with targets runs once per target.

reagents.description: One reagent per entry in targets (e.g. a different medium per culture chamber).

factors.description: culture only: one factor reagent per target, added through each lane's factor port.

valve_state.description: valve only: the state to set.

exchange_interval_s.description: culture only: time between batch medium exchanges (stop-flow in between).

waste.description: exchange only: the outlet port the liquid drains to (e.g. a dedicated oil waste). Default: the chamber's waste outlet.

flows_ul_h.description: encapsulate only: core, shell and oil flows in uL/h.

capsules.description: encapsulate only: how many capsules to make.

source.description: transfer only: where the cells start.

dilution.description: mix only: dilution factor, or 'auto' to let the operator set it from the last count (Module 1b).

variant.description: Optional. Run this step only when the run's variant (a chip run parameter) has this value, e.g. interaction.

duration_s.description: How long the step takes, in seconds.

temp_c.description: Temperature in degrees C, or null.

washes.description: Number of fill-and-drain cycles for an exchange, or null.

flow_ul_min.description: Flow rate in microlitres per minute, or null.

note.description: Plain-English description. Shown as narration in the twin.

direction.description: Optional, exchange only. backflush pushes liquid up through the mesh to lift capsules off it.

exchange_kind.description: Optional, exchange only. What the exchange is FOR, which is what sets its volume. This distinction used to live only in English inside `note`, where no tool could read it, so one rule could not tell a half medium change from a failed wash. partial: a deliberate fractional change of the chamber's liquid, typically a routine culture medium half-change. It is NOT trying to clear the chamber - the conditioned medium left behind is the point - so the one-chamber-volume floor does NOT apply, and the note must say what fraction of the chamber is replaced. sweep: clearing the chamber's contents - a wash, a rinse, a stage-medium change or a reagent clear-out. It MUST move at least one chamber volume and is normally several, sized from exchange.target_fraction: a well-mixed chamber keeps exp(-V) of the old liquid after V chamber volumes, so reaching the target needs -ln(1 - exchange.target_fraction) chamber volumes in total, and below one chamber volume the step cannot clear the chamber however many times it is repeated. fill: the first filling of an empty or air-filled chamber, bounded ABOVE by the chamber's volume_ul (a fill cannot put in more than the chamber holds) and with no lower bound. A step with NO exchange_kind is treated as sweep, the STRICT default: absence must never be the loophole, so an unclassified exchange is held to the sweep rule and the floor applies to it.

feed.description: Ports driven as a pressure source. A driven port is a source, not a block.

vent.description: Ports vented to act as the drain.

cap.description: Ports capped shut. Only a capped port is a true block.

ports.description: Optional. The port state for this step, for chips that route by port rather than by valve. A port id may appear in at most one of feed, vent and cap (not enforceable in JSON Schema; the validator should check it).

cycles.description: Optional, hold_temp only. Repeat the temperature profile count times, ramping at ramp_c_s degrees C per second between holds (thermocycling).
